# Young White Dragon (`monsters:young-white-dragon`)
*Large dragon, chaotic evil* | **CR** 6 (XP 2,300; PB +3)
**AC** 17 | **HP** 123 (13d10 + 52) | **Speed** 40 ft., burrow 20 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
**STR** 18 (+4) | **DEX** 10 (+0) | **CON** 18 (+4) | **INT** 6 (-2) | **WIS** 11 (+0) | **CHA** 12 (+1)
**Saving Throws:** [Saving Throw: DEX](../proficiencies/saving-throw-dex.md) +3, [Saving Throw: INT](../proficiencies/saving-throw-int.md) +2, [Saving Throw: WIS](../proficiencies/saving-throw-wis.md) +3
**Skills:** [Skill: Perception](../proficiencies/skill-perception.md) +6, [Skill: Stealth](../proficiencies/skill-stealth.md) +3
**Damage Immunities:** cold
**Senses:** Darkvision 120 ft., Blindsight 30 ft., Passive Perception 16
**Languages:** Common, Draconic

## Traits
- **Ice Walk.** The dragon can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, Difficult Terrain composed of ice or snow doesn’t cost it extra movement.

## Actions
- **Multiattack.** The dragon makes three Rend attacks.
- **Rend.** Melee Attack Roll: +7, reach 10 ft. Hit: 9 (2d4 + 4) Slashing damage plus 2 (1d4) Cold damage.
- **Cold Breath (Recharge 5+ (1d6)).** Constitution Saving Throw: DC 15, each creature in a 30-foot Cone. Failure: 40 (9d8) Cold damage. Success: Half damage.
